name: ba-kit
description: PeoplesHR tooling for Business Analysts. Ships the phx-write-frd skill for authoring the Feature Requirements Document (FRD) against the template held in the PHR-X project wiki, and declares the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. phx-write-frd needs a per-developer Azure DevOps MCP server, which this plugin does not ship. phx-business-context moved to the org-standards plugin in 2.0.0.
